resources.string: A 24 hour dial of the world\'s exchange trading sessions.
A 24 hour dial of the world\'s stock exchange sessions, as a home screen widget. Green bands are trading now, grey bands are the next session. Tap the widget to open the full web app.
Add the widget to my home screen
Android is not letting this app schedule exact alarms, so the dial hands may lag by a few minutes. The digital time keeps ticking either way.
Your launcher cannot add widgets this way. Long press the home screen, choose Widgets, then find Market Sessions.
